inputs.original_text: Daijiworld Media Network - Palakkad Palakkad, Mar 28: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, asserting that the accusations are politically....
inputs.modified_text: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan is denying on Saturday that there is any Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, claiming the accusations are politically motivated. This is nothing more than the typical evasion from left-wing leaders who put protecting their power above facing real accountability. Progressive arrangements like this only encourage waste and graft as they turn their backs on personal responsibility and the traditional structures that maintain order. It's time we demanded honest governance based on national integrity and family values rather than allowing these excuses to cover up the corruption.
